intermediateProblems.problem: Edit-active tattoo UV map was not source render UV0; strict tile mapping rejected unexpected tile.
intermediateProblems.fix: Select and preserve source render-active UVMap, remove unused auxiliary map. No arbitrary tile fallback.

intermediateProblems.problem: 111 source masked loose vertices and 110 wire edges absent in GLB, causing 2 point/bounds failures.
intermediateProblems.fix: Remove only vertices with no linked surface faces; zero surface faces removed.

intermediateProblems.problem: Hair, brows and shirt too pale; stare too wide.
intermediateProblems.fix: One targeted correction: darker/rougher hair, muted sage shirt, slightly lower existing upper lids and raised existing mouth corners; light power scaled .55.

intermediateProblems.problem: Source polygon material indices were reset by slot clearing; unused source color attributes darkened glTF. Shader tint nodes were not a safe portable representation.
intermediateProblems.fix: Preserve polygon material indices, remove unused color attributes, bake existing linear multipliers to textures. Geometry/form/look settings otherwise unchanged.

intermediateProblems.problem: Null mode had no active URP shader subshader; fresh probe lacked built-in PNG decoding modules.
intermediateProblems.fix: D3D11 render initializes URP; enable already installed Image Conversion and Unity Web Request Texture modules. Fail missing texture bindings and actual importer Error/Exception messages. Retain optional specular warning.
